assoc_derived_note.en: Derived for information only. Not a decision threshold.
assoc_derived_note.zh-TW: 僅供參考的推導值，並非判定門檻。
assoc_derived_note.note: Derived for information only. Not a decision threshold.

assoc_overlap_note.en: {@term.host_observations} in overlapping windows may be reported as Ambiguous.
assoc_overlap_note.zh-TW: 位於重疊時間窗內的{@term.host_observation}可能被標示為模糊。

auto_stop_invalid.en: Auto Stop Duration must be a finite positive time as seconds or hh:mm:ss.
auto_stop_invalid.zh-TW: 自動停止時長須為大於 0 的秒數或 hh:mm:ss。

auto_stop_off_button.note: Toggle token. Keep identical in both languages; current UI does not translate OFF/ON.

auto_stop_on_button.note: Toggle token. Keep identical in both languages; current UI does not translate OFF/ON.

custom_limits_invalid.en: Custom Limits must be finite positive numbers.
custom_limits_invalid.zh-TW: 自訂上限必須為大於 0 的有限數字。

custom_limits_order_invalid.en: Chatter must be below double-click, and actuation-too-short must be below low-hold warning.
custom_limits_order_invalid.zh-TW: Chatter 必須小於雙擊門檻，且按壓過短必須小於低按壓警示。

fixture_timing_tolerance_invalid.en: {@term.schedule_association_window} is required: enter a finite number of ms (0 or greater).
fixture_timing_tolerance_invalid.zh-TW: 必須設定{@term.schedule_association_window}：請輸入 0 以上的有限毫秒數。

fixture_warn.en: {@term.mode_fixture} mode needs a click fixture at the set Hz. Hand-clicking will usually WARN.
fixture_warn.zh-TW: {@term.mode_fixture}模式需以設定 Hz 敲擊；手按通常會 WARN。

listen_hint.en: Lock the Setup profile before capture.
listen_hint.zh-TW: 擷取前請先鎖定設定檔。

page_setup_subtitle.zh-TW: 擷取前先設定測試條件。

interval_comparison_invalid.en: Configured tolerance must be a finite number of 0 or greater.
interval_comparison_invalid.zh-TW: 設定容差必須為 0 以上的有限數字。

interval_comparison_ms_range.en: Millisecond tolerance must be between 0 and the {@term.reference_interval} inclusive.
interval_comparison_ms_range.zh-TW: 毫秒容差必須介於 0 與{@term.reference_interval}之間（含）。

interval_comparison_percent_range.en: Percent tolerance must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
interval_comparison_percent_range.zh-TW: 百分比容差必須介於 0 與 100 之間（含）。

profile_status_draft.en: Setup Draft — lock the profile before capture.
profile_status_draft.zh-TW: 設定草稿 — 擷取前請先鎖定設定檔。

reference_rate_invalid.en: {@term.reference_rate} must be a finite positive number.
reference_rate_invalid.zh-TW: {@term.reference_rate}必須為大於 0 的有限數字。

screening_measurement_only_note.en: No approved screening or validation profile is applied.
screening_measurement_only_note.zh-TW: 未套用核准的篩查或驗證設定檔。
screening_measurement_only_note.note: No approved screening or validation profile is applied.
